bullets.title: NVDA: Jensen Huang reinstated as CEO — relief rally +31%, but headwinds persist
bullets.body: Jensen Huang was reinstated as NVDA President, CEO, and Board member, triggering a +31.5% rally Monday (NDX +6.9%, S&P +4.73%, best day in 19 months). However, pre-market Tuesday sees NVDA -5.6% as concerns remain: bipartisan lawmakers vow tighter export controls ahead of Huang's Dec 3 Senate testimony, Singapore's Megaspeed added to trade blacklist, DoJ probes continue, and UBS notes broad data center estimate cuts were not reversed by the news. Citi investors said they are 'not inclined to chase NVDA' citing over-earning risk and tough 2027 compares.

bullets.title: CRWD: Record Q3 beat + acquires Zscaler for ~$44B all-stock; multiple upgrades
bullets.body: CRWD posted record F3Q27: revenue $1.58B (+28% YoY, beat $1.53B est), net new ARR $419M (+58% YoY, crushed ~$345M guide), and ARR $6.26B (+27%). FY27 net new ARR guidance raised to $1.459B-$1.463B (44-45% YoY growth). Simultaneously, CRWD announced acquisition of Zscaler in a 100% all-stock deal valued ~$43.9B (1.135x exchange ratio, ~10x CY27 EV/S), targeting ~$1B revenue synergies by 30 months post-close. Guggenheim upgraded to Buy ($280 PT), D.A. Davidson reiterates Buy ($245 PT); CRWD stock down ~8.9% post-announcement on deal dilution concerns.

bullets.title: MRVL: Opco/RBC lower PT but remain bullish ahead of Dec 1 F3Q; AI custom ASIC story intact
bullets.body: Oppenheimer cut MRVL PT to $325 from $425 on group multiple compression but reiterates Outperform, flagging networking >70% growth this year and custom ASIC revenue expected to double to $4B+ in CY27 and exceed $10B by CY28 (Trainium, Maia on track). RBC raises to Outperform with $250 PT citing >50% FY28 topline growth potential and hyperscaler custom chip wins; stock trades ~19x CY27E EPS. MRVL reports Dec 1 (consensus $1.10 EPS, $3.15B revenue).

bullets.title: HPE: Big F4Q beat and raised FY27 guidance, but investors cautious on margins and 2027 compares
bullets.body: HPE reported F4Q EPS $1.43 vs consensus $1.28, revenue $14.55B; Cloud & AI EBIT margins beat with AI systems orders $4.5B record. FY27 guidance raised to 27-35% revenue growth (from 13-17%), EPS +27-35%, FCF $5.5B+. Despite the beat, HPE is -9.8% to -12% pre-market Tuesday as Citi and others flag back-half-weighted revenue mix (46/54 split), margin moderation in Cloud/AI to ~14% for FY27, and investor concern about hardware over-earning into tough 2027 compares. HPE authorized additional $5B buyback.

bullets.title: DELL: Setup seen strong ahead of tonight's earnings; AI server guidance could reach $80B+
bullets.body: UBS sees DELL October Q revenue potentially exceeding $51B (+4% vs $49.9B consensus) and AI server revenue reaching $21B+ vs $19B guide. FY27 AI-server guidance could rise to $80B+ from $74B; FY27 EPS potentially ~$27 vs $25.50 prior. DELL reports today at 16:30 ET (consensus $6.60 EPS, $49.32B revenue). Stock is -7% in pre-market Tuesday in sympathy with HPE weakness.

bullets.title: ADI: F4Q beats across the board; F1Q EPS guide slightly below on opex step-up
bullets.body: ADI reported F4Q revenue $4.37B (+42% YoY), non-GAAP EPS $4.06 (beat $3.90 consensus), gross margin 74.5% vs 73.9% expected, and operating margin 52.3%. F1Q guidance revenue $4.40B (above consensus $4.36B) but EPS $3.82 below consensus $3.88 due to opex increase driving 180bps OM contraction. KeyBanc maintains Overweight ($525 PT). Notably, more than two-thirds of FY26 growth came from non-AI markets; Industrial led at +11% q/q.

bullets.title: MU: BNP Paribas Exane downgrades to neutral; stock -6.9% pre-market
bullets.body: BNP Paribas Exane downgraded Micron from outperform to neutral with a $775 PT (10% upside from $707.70), diverging significantly from the FactSet consensus target of $1,601. MU is down 6.9% in pre-market Tuesday as part of a broad semiconductor selloff after Monday's AI-driven rally.

bullets.title: AMZN: Acquires Decart for ~$7.5B to boost AWS AI chip utilization and Trainium competitiveness
bullets.body: Amazon is acquiring Decart's AI optimization technology and team for ~$7.5B. Decart's Optimization Stack (DOS) enables models to run on Trainium3 at 80%+ FLOPS utilization vs. the 40-50% industry average, targeting inference (now 50%+ of AWS AI revenue). Trainium external sales planned for late 2027; Decart DOS expected to drive adoption. Citi reiterates Buy with $350 PT, projecting AWS reaches $1T in revenue by 2032E (33.5% CAGR).

bullets.title: TTWO: GTA VI blockbuster — DA Davidson raises FY27 bookings to $10.2B; PT raised to $300
bullets.body: DA Davidson raises TTWO FY27 topline bookings estimate to $10.2B from $8.8B on GTA VI dominance: 68.5% share of hours played among top 100 games in first 4-5 days, 24.9 average hours per player vs Fortnite's 5.8, and 45M copies sold (largest PS launch ever). GTA Online expected to launch next year, modeling ~$2B FY28 revenue. RBLX platform CCUs only down 1.9% W/W despite GTA VI launch, suggesting minimal competitive overlap.

bullets.title: META: JPM cuts PT to $775 from $940; core ads strong but AI cost overhang
bullets.body: JPM cut META's PT from $940 to $775, citing 2027 guidance of $210-220B opex and ~$250B capex — the market is pricing in AI costs but not the AI revenue benefit. Core advertising remains strong with 3Q ad revenue +26% YoY and UCAN +33% YoY. Meta's Muse AI agent saw 600k daily downloads on 11/22 with global rollout expanding.

bullets.title: SHOP: UCP adoption at 15% of top e-commerce sites; partner network growth decelerating
bullets.body: Piper Sandler notes Shopify's Unified Commerce Platform adoption reached 15.1% of Top 2,500 e-commerce sites (up from 14% in September), with Fortune 1000 adoption at 0.9% (doubled since May). Recent enterprise adopters include IKEA, On Running, Clinique, Wilson, Canada Goose, Verizon, HP, and PayPal. However, the Partner Network tracker decelerated to 25% YoY growth through early November vs. 30%+ prior.

bullets.title: INTU: HSBC downgrades to Hold; PT cut to $292 from $657
bullets.body: HSBC downgraded Intuit to Hold from Buy and slashed the PT to $292 from $657. No detailed rationale provided in the sources, but the action is noted across multiple broker morning summaries as a notable downgrade.

bullets.title: NFLX: Submits highest bid for 2030 World Cup US media rights, ahead of Amazon and Fox
bullets.body: JPM reports Netflix submitted the highest bid for 2030 FIFA World Cup US media rights, topping competing bids from Amazon and the Fox/Univision consortium. No deal terms disclosed yet.

bullets.title: UBER/TSLA/GOOGL: Nuro-Lucid-Uber begin driverless testing on Bay Area public roads; Q1 2027 launch
bullets.body: Nuro, Lucid, and Uber have commenced driverless vehicle testing on public roads in the San Francisco Bay Area, with employee rides to begin shortly. A public launch is targeted for Q1 2027, adding competitive pressure to Tesla's and Waymo's robotaxi timelines.

bullets.title: HOOD: GS raises PT to $114 on retail volume inflection and product expansion
bullets.body: Goldman Sachs raised HOOD's PT to $114, citing retail equity volumes up 14% MTD November, 20%+ structural net new asset growth, and product expansion. The brokers/crypto group is down 23% since 10/15 with valuations near five-year troughs; GS also raised IBKR PT to $104 and FIGR PT to $35.

bullets.title: CRDO/CIEN/COHR/GLW: JPM raises Datacom TAM to $88B by 2030 on 800G and integrated optics surge
bullets.body: JPM revised the Datacom TAM to $88B by 2030 (~20% CAGR 2026-2030), up from $70B prior, driven by 800G optics peaking at ~$40B in 2028 and 1.6T expanding at 50% CAGR. Integrated optics (NPO/CPO) to reach $25B by 2030 (~28% of Datacom market). OCS market to triple to $8B+ by 2031, with Google as the anchor buyer (45%+ share). JPM rates CIEN, CRDO overweight; COHR, GLW neutral.

bullets.title: DUOL: DA Davidson flags DAU acceleration 80-110bps ahead of guidance/consensus
bullets.body: DA Davidson upgraded Duolingo to Buy citing 4QTD YoY DAU weekly growth tracking 80-110bps ahead of guidance and consensus, with a notable step-up in week-over-week growth. This is the primary catalyst behind the upgrade.

bullets.title: MDB: DA Davidson upgrades to Buy; Atlas growth expected 28-29% vs 26% guidance
bullets.body: DA Davidson upgraded MongoDB to Buy, with Atlas growth expected at 28-29% YoY vs. the 26% guidance, and EA & Other ARR showing acceleration. MDB reports Dec 1 at 17:00 ET (consensus $1.61 EPS, $762.5M revenue).

bullets.title: W: Mizuho reiterates Outperform at $140 PT on market share gains and physical store expansion
bullets.body: Mizuho raised conviction on Wayfair, flagging accelerating US revenue via Wayfair Rewards (1M+ paying members), LLM integration as an early OpenAI ads partner, and physical store expansion (40-50 large-format stores at 70K-150K sq ft targeting $1-2B at scale). Consignment model limits inventory risk. PT $140 based on ~18x FY28E EBITDA.

bullets.title: Broad semi selloff pre-market Tuesday: AMD -4.9%, MRVL -5.7%, CRWV -6.0%, VRT -5.7%
bullets.body: After Monday's historic AI rally, pre-market Tuesday sees broad semiconductor and AI infrastructure names giving back gains: NVDA -5.6%, AMD -4.9%, MU -6.9%, SNDK -7.0%, MRVL -5.7%, CRWV -6.0%, VRT -5.7%, COHR -5.1%, CIEN -4.9%, TXN -5.2%, MTSI -4.9%. HPE -12% on margin concerns dragging DELL -7%. S&P futures -0.9%, Nasdaq 100 futures -1.6%. Fed hawkishness (Williams reiterating rate hikes needed) and tightening financial conditions are the primary macro headwinds.
